journal_lines: All three at once. The forest, the rock, and the prey gave way together. A rare kind of day.
Prey flushed from the tree line into a cave seam. Took all three to sort it out. Worth it.
The hunt led through timber into stone. Everyone worked. Everything counted.
A day when each of us did the work of one and the work of all three. Tired in the right way after.
Trees, stone, prey: all three asked for a paw, all three got one.
The kind of expedition you remember. Came back with one of everything.
Three tasks, one wolf, one long day. Came home with everything that had been asked for.
Forest, mountain, quarry — the whole world worked today. So did we.
